notes.title: Ghosts, Questions, and a Little Update
notes.notes:
Hello again,

This one’s short but spooky 👻

A Story of Questions is now part of the Hungry Ghost Festival on Steam!
It’s a special event highlighting haunting, atmospheric horror games, so if you’ve been thinking about wishlisting, now’s a perfect time.


[previewyoutube="F_T6DPRoCJ8;full"][/previewyoutube]A Quiet Month…
You may have noticed it’s been a little quiet around here. That’s because I’ve been working away on something special for the game. I can’t share details just yet, but let’s just say it’s bigger than a plush duck this time 😉



Every Choice Still Matters

In case you’re new here:
A Story of Questions is a narrative-driven horror mystery about choices.
Small ones, like opening a box or playing a tape.
Bigger ones, like answering a question that may change everything.
Every choice closes a door… and opens another.#



What’s Next?

For now, I’ll keep building in the background, but I wanted to drop by, share the event, and say thank you for sticking with me even when things get quiet.

Your support (and wishlists) mean the world 💛

👉 The Hungry Ghost Festival Event Link



Until next time,

- Tim

Under the Bridge Games
